scope.description: Competitors and substitutes for an Enable U-style provider of managed integration, API trust, public-sector interoperability and governed data services in the Netherlands and Europe.
inclusionLogic: Include specialists that combine integration technology and managed services
Include Dutch platforms competing for public-sector and regulated workloads
Include global platforms customers can buy directly or through another partner
Treat Azure and Boomi as partners and self-build substitutes, not simply direct competitors
notes: Only business statistics with an explicit source are included.
Competitive categories and positioning are analytical inferences from public product pages, not claims made by the companies.
Pricing, revenue and win-rate comparisons are omitted because reliable comparable public data was not found.

players.name: Enable U
players.description: Dutch specialist combining its own OpenTunnel platform with Azure, Boomi and Layer7 expertise, managed integrations, government interoperability, data management and transaction services. Differentiates through public-sector depth and a build-plus-run model.

players.name: Yenlo
players.description: Multi-vendor API, integration, identity and iPaaS specialist with managed services and Dutch-government solutions. A close substitute when customers want one specialist across platforms and 24/7 operations.

players.name: eMagiz
players.description: Dutch low-code iPaaS centered on messaging, API gateway, event streaming and integration lifecycle management. Competes on one coherent platform and rapid model-driven delivery.

players.name: WeAreFrank!
players.description: Open-source Frank!Framework and Frank as a Service offer a Dutch/EU-hosted integration alternative emphasizing sovereignty, predictable cost and managed operation without a US hyperscaler dependency.

players.name: MuleSoft
players.description: Salesforce's broad API and integration platform is a substitute for enterprises prioritizing a global ecosystem, enterprise governance and platform standardization over a Dutch public-sector specialist.

players.name: Microsoft Azure Integration Services
players.description: The native Azure services underlying Easy Integration can also be assembled and operated directly by a customer or another partner. Enable U competes by adding a standard foundation, traceability, migration and managed lifecycle.

players.name: Boomi
players.description: Boomi is both a core technology partner and a substitute when customers buy and operate iPaaS directly. Enable U adds Dutch market context, implementation, reusable connectors and managed operation.

players.name: IBM webMethods
players.description: A mature hybrid integration and API-management suite that competes in complex enterprises with large existing middleware estates and global vendor relationships.
